title: Mosh
description: Album covers as a broken video stream — swipe across one and its blocks tear into slabs that melt on for seconds in the next record's colours. Tap and the frame snaps clean, block by block, in a diagonal sweep.
intent: One P-frame datamosh simulator finished to the edge: painted motion vectors that tear then melt, a block-gated residual and a progressive keyframe, on real covers.
